title: Probing Ethical Framework Representations in Large Language Models: Structure, Entanglement, and Methodological Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Training linear logistic regression probes on frozen hidden states using the ETHICS benchmark to decode framework-specific patterns (deontology, utilitarianism, virtue, justice, commonsense) and analyzing cross-framework transfer, structural entanglement, and internal probe conflicts.

Comparing probe transfer patterns and framework generalization failures on the Western-centric ETHICS benchmark between Western-trained models and a Chinese-trained model (DeepSeek-R1) to identify cultural-philosophical training differences.
